## Problem 1


```{r}
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
```

### Description of the pengiuns dataset

The `penguins` dataset contains measurements on penguins from three species:
`r paste(unique(penguins$species), collapse = ", ")`.
Important variables include species, island, bill length, bill depth,
flipper length, body mass, sex, and year.

The dataset contains `r nrow(penguins)` rows and `r ncol(penguins)` columns

The mean flipper length is `r mean(penguins$flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)` mm.

### Scatterplot

```{r}

penguin_plot =
  ggplot(
    penguins,
    aes(
      x = bill_length_mm,
      y = flipper_length_mm,
      color = species
    )
  ) +
  geom_point()

penguin_plot
